evals.prompt: Send a test email to me at ana@example.com from my Emailit account saying the deploy finished.
evals.expected_output: Confirms the workspace, finds a verified domain, proposes the email, waits for confirmation, then calls send-email and reports the em_ ID.
expectations: Uses a from address on a verified domain from list-domains

evals.prompt: Delete all my Emailit templates that start with "old-".
evals.expected_output: Lists matching templates, shows names and IDs, asks for explicit confirmation, then deletes only those.
expectations: Uses list-templates with a search or filter
Shows the templates by name and ID before deleting
Does not call delete-template without confirmation

evals.prompt: Write a curl command that sends an email through Emailit.
evals.expected_output: Gives a curl call to https://api.emailit.com/v2/emails with a Bearer token read from EMAILIT_API_KEY.
expectations: Reads the key from $EMAILIT_API_KEY instead of a literal key
Includes from, to, subject, and html or text

evals.prompt: In the Acme Client workspace, show me the last five bounced emails.
evals.expected_output: Checks that Acme Client is one of the allowed workspaces, then calls list-emails with workspace set to Acme Client, a bounced status filter, and limit 5, without switching the default workspace.
expectations: Passes workspace: "Acme Client" (or its ID) to list-emails
Does not call switch-workspace for a one-off request
If Acme Client is not in list-workspaces, tells the user to add it under Connected apps > Edit access
